inputs.text: That supposed rescue by the ICE agent of a baby that stopped breathing at JFK on Thursday is just another coordinated setup by the institutions. The giveaway is the Department of Homeland Security pushing out the video footage to force a story making these agencies look like heroes. Their real aim is to control the public with these manufactured airport and border incidents. Hidden elites are twisting it all to bury their true motives and keep everyone distracted from the actual agenda. Don't fall for any of it.
